text:
Predicates:
SportingEvent(x) ::: x is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympics(x) ::: x is the last summer Olympic games.
Location(x, y) ::: x was held in y.
WonMostMedals(x, y) ::: x won the most medals in y.
Premises:
SportingEvent(summerOlympics) ::: The summer Olympic games is a sporting event.
LastSummerOlympics(summerOlympics) ∧ Location(summerOlympics, tokyo) ::: The last summer Olympic games was in Tokyo.
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, tokyo) ::: The United States won the most medals in Tokyo.
Conclusion:
WonMostMedals(unitedStates, summerOlympics) ::: The United States won the most medals in the last summer Olympic games.
